questions.prompt: `[ $name = admin ]` errors when name holds `admin user`, but `[[ $name = admin ]]` works. Why?

options.b: [[ is parsed as syntax BEFORE expansion — its operand positions are fixed, so the result never word-splits; [ is just a command receiving whatever words survive expansion

questions.prompt: `(( 5 ))` exits 0 and `(( 0 ))` exits 1. What's going on?

options.b: two opposite conventions meeting: in arithmetic nonzero is TRUE, and true is then reported as exit code 0

questions.prompt: A script's shebang is #!/bin/sh and it must stay dash-safe (L0.3). Which test tool is available?

options.c: [ ] — the POSIX test command; [[ and (( are bashisms (shellcheck would say SC3010)
